SELECT
p.product_id AS productId,
p.product_name AS productName,
c.category_name AS categoryName,
s.user_id AS sellerId,
s.user_name AS sellerName,
p.product_price AS productPrice,
COALESCE( SUM(o.quantity), 0 ) AS quantitySold,
COALESCE( SUM(o.total_price), 0 ) AS revenue,
COALESCE( AVG(r.rating), 0 ) AS averageRating,
COUNT(DISTINCT r.review_id) AS reviewCount
FROM products p
INNER JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
INNER JOIN sellers s ON p.user_id = s.user_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.product_id = o.product_id
LEFT JOIN review r ON p.product_id = r.product_id
LEFT JOIN payments pay ON o.order_id = pay.order_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND p.user_id = #{sellerId}
AND o.customer_id = #{customerId}
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.product_id = #{productId}
AND LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE CONCAT( '%', LOWER(#{productName}), '%' )
AND p.product_price >= #{minPrice}
AND p.product_price <= #{maxPrice}
AND o.quantity >= #{minQuantity}
AND o.quantity <= #{maxQuantity}
AND o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
AND pay.payment_status = #{paymentStatus}
AND o.order_date >= STR_TO_DATE( #{fromDate}, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i' )
AND o.order_date <= STR_TO_DATE( #{toDate}, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i' )
GROUP BY
p.product_id, p.product_name, c.category_name, s.user_id, s.user_name, p.product_price
ORDER BY quantitySold DESC

SELECT
s.user_id AS sellerId,
s.user_name AS sellerName,
s.shop_name AS shopName,
COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount,
COALESCE( SUM(o.quantity), 0 ) AS quantitySold,
COALESCE( SUM(o.total_price), 0 ) AS revenue
FROM sellers s
INNER JOIN products p ON s.user_id = p.user_id
LEFT JOIN orders o ON p.product_id = o.product_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND s.user_id = #{sellerId}
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.product_id = #{productId}
AND p.product_price >= #{minPrice}
AND p.product_price <= #{maxPrice}
AND o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
AND o.order_date >= STR_TO_DATE( #{fromDate}, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i' )
AND o.order_date <= STR_TO_DATE( #{toDate}, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i' )
GROUP BY
s.user_id, s.user_name, s.shop_name
ORDER BY revenue DESC

SELECT
c.user_id AS customerId,
c.user_name AS customerName,
COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orderCount,
COALESCE( SUM(o.quantity), 0 ) AS quantityPurchased,
COALESCE( SUM(o.total_price), 0 ) AS totalSpent,
COALESCE( AVG(o.total_price), 0 ) AS averageOrderValue
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON c.user_id = o.customer_id
LEFT JOIN products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.user_id = #{customerId}
AND p.category_id = #{categoryId}
AND p.product_id = #{productId}
AND LOWER(p.product_name) LIKE CONCAT( '%', LOWER(#{productName}), '%' )
AND p.product_price >= #{minPrice}
AND p.product_price <= #{maxPrice}
AND o.order_status = #{orderStatus}
AND o.order_date >= STR_TO_DATE( #{fromDate}, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i' )
AND o.order_date <= STR_TO_DATE( #{toDate}, '%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i' )
GROUP BY
c.user_id, c.user_name
